product_one_liner.value: koppla is collaborative construction-scheduling software that helps general contractors, general planners, project developers, and architects plan and manage construction timelines, reduce project risks, and improve profitability.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes project and company licence plans; listed plans count even though pricing is customized.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in koppla’s “reviewed and trusted by” customer-logo section.

hq_location.notes: The official imprint gives the company address in Potsdam, Germany.

eng_blog.notes: The index is a construction/marketing and product-use blog; it does not show at least two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public help center has multiple collections and articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The job-board snapshot dated 2026-11-09 lists one Senior Product Engineer role, not an AI/ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The AI page describes its feature and data handling but does not name an AI model/provider; the trust-center subprocessor listing also does not identify one.

compliance_certs.notes: These two of the requested certification names appear in the trust center; TISAX is also listed but is outside the requested set.

last_funding.notes: The round was announced in May 2025 as €6 million; Seedtable reports the Series A equivalent as $6.8 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding announcement is dated 2025-05-19, within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The 2026-11-09 job-board snapshot lists a Senior Product Engineer role, not an SDR, BDR, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: A 2026-05-27 company post describes its new BIM integration, inside the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The identified VP Product and VP Revenue start dates are 2025-06 and 2025-09, before the window; Newion reports the former CEO’s departure occurred in 2024. No qualifying C-level/VP join or departure in 2025-11-09 through 2026-11-09 was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job post refers to a CRM generically but names no CRM or sales/marketing platform.
